say:1:1130328001:1.text: Anyone in the Grimmaw Clan knows that Kruger is no less powerful than Orson.
say:1:1130328001:1.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族的任何人都知道，克鲁格的实力完全不输给奥格。
say:1:1130328001:1.male: Anyone in the Grimmaw Clan knows that Kruger is no less powerful than Orson.
say:1:1130328001:1.female: Anyone in the Grimmaw Clan knows that Kruger is no less powerful than Orson.

say:2:1130328002:1.text: He's also more level-headed, knowing when to be cautious and show restraint. He has all the makings of a great leader.
say:2:1130328002:1.source_cn: 而且他沉稳内敛，谨慎克制，有着更明显的领袖气质。
say:2:1130328002:1.male: He's also more level-headed, knowing when to be cautious and show restraint. He has all the makings of a great leader.
say:2:1130328002:1.female: He's also more level-headed, knowing when to be cautious and show restraint. He has all the makings of a great leader.

say:3:1130328003:1.text: Personally, I believe Kruger is a far more fit to lead than Orson.
say:3:1130328003:1.source_cn: 就我个人而言，克鲁格比奥格更适合成为领袖。
say:3:1130328003:1.male: Personally, I believe Kruger is a far more fit to lead than Orson.
say:3:1130328003:1.female: Personally, I believe Kruger is a far more fit to lead than Orson.
